2.1.158 (Claude Code)
Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]
--bare
--disable-slash-commands
--no-session-persistence
--strict-mcp-config
--mcp-config <configs...>
--tools <tools...>
--output-format <format>
--json-schema <schema>
--permission-mode <mode>
--model <model>
--effort <level>
--print
